messages:
anya: @eng-ml incoming customer request to onboard Starlark-18B (customer: Vecura). They want private VPC deployment, 4-bit quant (q4_0 or q4_1), seq_len 2048, chat latency SLO ~150ms p95. Attaching eval summary link: https://internal/vecura/starlark-eval. Need triage: perf feasibility, quant path, tokenizer quirks, KV-cache compatibility, and a rough cost ballpark.

max: ack. do we have FP16/safetensors checkpoints or only pytorch .bin? any sharded format?

anya: customer provided HF repo: hf.co/vecura/starlark-18b — looks like regular pytorch .bin and tokenizer.json + merges. no safetensors yet.

lee: pinging infra/quant teams. q4_0 is our usual start. need to confirm CUDA/ROCm kernel coverage. also check attention type (rotary vs absolute) — that affects kernel selection.

olivia: quick tokenizer check: looks like byte-level bpe, vocab ~50k. they included config.json; pos embeddings = learned absolute. will confirm attention in config.

samir: for private deploy, KV cache should be fine but 4-bit quant sometimes impacts cache replay fidelity. propose a diff smoke: run FP16 vs q4_0 on the provided prompt set (N=50) and compare top-k token diffs + lm perplexity delta.

anya: timeline from customer: PoC in 1 week, production in 6–8 weeks. they sent example transcripts (small).

jen: i'll queue smoke eval on a small GPU pool. command i plan to run: 
```
python -m ri_eval.smoke --model hf://vecura/starlark-18b --dtype q4_0 --batch 1 --seq 512 --out results.json
```
will run FP16 baseline and q4_0.

ci-bot: Job queued: eval-smoke-2203456792 by jen. ETA ~2h :hourglass_flowing_sand:

max: add metric checks: perplexity delta, exact-match on canonical responses, token-level edit distance, and top-k distribution shift (KL). also monitor logits for blown-up values.

olivia: confirmed: config.json shows rotary embeddings, n_ctx 2048, head_dim 64, attention implementation = scaled-rope. that means we use our rotary kernels (good).

samir: assignment: jen + olivia run smoke + tokenizer checks. max will do quant tuning (q4_0 -> q4_1 if needed). lee to vet private infra compat (KMS, network egress rules). i'll draft reply to customer outlining expected blockers (license, safetensors, perf delta).

anya: thanks — please capture results to the intake doc (internal: /onboard/starlark-18b/). if regressions >5% perplexity or >10% token-edit drift, escalate to research.

max: one more: confirm license on hf repo (Vecura license field looks custom). if private deploy requires redistribution, legal review required.

anya: legal already looped in. will wait on smoke results then update the customer with a tentative timeline.

jen: starting FP16 -> q4_0 runs now. will post results and a short CSV of deltas here.

lee: if we hit an attention kernel gap on ROCm, we can fallback to hosting on Dedicated GPUs for the PoC and plan a later on-prem integration.

anya: cool. ping me when smoke done. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: eval-smoke-2203456792 completed. results: /artifacts/evals/2203456792/results.json (jen).

jen: quick summary: q4_0 perplexity +3.2% vs FP16 on sample set. token-edit median 2 tokens per response. no catastrophic failures. attaching small diff table.

max: that delta looks acceptable for PoC. next: run an aggressive hallucination/regression suite and a few safety checks before handing to customer.

anya: great. i'll propose PoC plan to Vecura: host on Dedicated for PoC with q4_0, run 2-week eval, then revisit for Private deployment.

samir: noted. closing triage for now — will reopen if regression suite finds issues.
